title: Automated Partner Billing Exports
summary: Generate recurring financial reports per DBA with automated delivery to partners
findings: Partners currently request manual billing breakdowns. Automation would reduce admin overhead and improve partner satisfaction. Similar features in competitor platforms show 40% reduction in support tickets.
dependencies: Stripe API integration for billing data
next_steps: Survey partners on preferred report formats, estimate Stripe API usage costs, prototype PDF templates

title: White-Label Provisioning Wizard
summary: Script-based wizard to spin up new DBA projects with zero-code setup
findings: Current DBA setup requires manual configuration across Vercel, DNS, analytics, and environment variables. Automation would enable faster partnership launches and reduce setup errors. Estimated 80% time savings (4 hours → 45 minutes).
opportunity_driver: Enable non-technical team members to provision DBAs
next_steps: Spike on Vercel/DNS API capabilities, design wizard UI flow, estimate API rate limits and costs, create rollback strategy
